instruction.text: Decide which things might be a reason someone asks you to keep a secret for them.

atoms.sound: they want to keep something private
they want lots of people to know

atoms.a: You should keep every secret you are told, even if it could hurt someone.

trainers.instruction: Read the secret and decide what you should do.

hint.text: If you are struggling to decide, think about whether anyone might be hurt by you keeping the secret.

atoms.a: A friend tells you that they are being hurt at home.
Your aunt is planning a surprise party for your mum.
A family member touched you inappropriately and is asking you not to tell anyone.

hint.text: Being touched inappropriately includes any type of physical contact that you are not comfortable with, including someone touching your private parts.
hint.label: Inappropriately

atoms.a: A friend tells you a funny but embarrassing thing that happened to them.
Someone tells you that they have stolen something.

feedback.finish: Some secrets might be harmful to keep. You should not keep a secret if someone is being hurt or if someone is doing something wrong.
Telling a trusted adult is the best option. They will know how to deal with the situation.

atoms.a: Who should you tell if you decide not to keep a secret for someone?
